entities.summary: Jon Robert "J.R." Holden is an American-Russian former professional basketball player and current basketball executive who is serving as a front office executive of the Detroit Pistons in the National Basketball Association (NBA). He was previously the director of player personal of the Brooklyn Nets. Holden was born in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. At 1.85 m tall, he could play at both the point guard and shooting guard positions, but he primarily played at point guard.
